crossRefs.note: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this…
They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.
“Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said…
Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to…
You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

translations.web: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
translations.bsb: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
translations.kjv: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
translations.asv: Thou hast made us an off-scouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.
